snippet.title: Moonrise Fall - Opening Cinematic
snippet.description:
Opening in-game cinematic for Moonrise Fall. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035110/Moonrise_Fall/

Explore... ​Investigate... Photograph...​ A Hidden World

​Moonrise Fall is an atmospheric exploration puzzle game about a boy who finds himself lost in a supernatural forest after losing both parents in a car crash. Armed with a clue filled journal, a camera, and a lantern he must unravel the mysteries of the forest and photograph the strange creatures that reside there.

https://www.moonrisefall.com/
